purpose: Single source of truth for canonical build-action argv. Before this file existed the same argv literals lived in three code tables (composition, reverse read-back, recipe) with no authority, so a command change required touching N sites with no proof they agreed. Every production site is a reader of this registry: the argv a builder executes for an action is declared exactly once here. The retired make:* spellings are absent by decision (they name Makefile targets that do not exist); legacy argv still reverse-resolves to them for old-evidence read-back, but nothing composes them.
